sources.excerpt: Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FITZO Home News Amps Pedals Custom Shop Download About Contact Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FITZO: Handcrafted Transparent Overdrive CRISPY, CRANKY OVERDRIVE Welcome to the world of FITZO, an overdrive pedal that amplifies your amp's natural tone, adding clarity and transparency to your boosted performance. FITZO is designed for perfect compatibility with your amplifier's genuine character, fresh from other overdrive pedals that often colour or smashes your original tone, too many times like a bad joke. Next Owner’s Manual Review… IN / OUT Input Input impedance : approx. 1 MΩ Output Output impedance : approx. 10 kΩ Push Switch GIMME Mechanical true-bypass switching of the FITZO circuit. LED Indicator Status LED Indicates when FITZO (GIMME) is ON. Potentiometers Drive Natural, crisp, amp-sounding overdrive from clean → medium dirty. Volume Output level. Bass Passive low-frequency tone control. Treble Passive high-frequency tone control. Internals * 2 × trimmers: Slope and Mid (factory default). * User-adjustable but not required. Power DC Input 9–18 V DC , very low current draw. Optional AC adapter: 9–18 V DC, center-pin negative (BOSS-style, regulated). Dimensions & Weight Size 111.6 × 61.6 × 50.0 mm (4.37 × 2.40 × 1.90 in) Weight Approx. 450 g (0.99 lbs) Colour / Finish May vary depending on season. From Oct 2024 onward: Raw aluminium / zinc chassis with black print . What You Get With This Cranker ► Sound and feel you have not experienced before ► 1 x 9 volts battery (6LR61) ► 1 x printed Owner’s Manual ► 1 x Warranty: The Himmelstrutz Elektro Art products includes a 1 year limited materials- and factory warranty (from delivery date). The warranty does not include batteries and consumables. Product service is free of charge during the warranty time. The warranty does not include errors due to product modifications, internal adjustments, disassembly, negligence/violence, incorrect power supply usage/incorrect connections or thunder.
